paragraphs: R' Nachum, brother of R' Ila.
Mentioned at the end of halakhah 2 in Beitzah, chapter 5, where he asked R' Yochanan a question.[^1][^2]

notes.text: פ״ה סה״ב is read contextually as chapter 5, end of halakhah 2. The format and בעי קומי suggest the Jerusalem Talmud, but no named edition is independently checked.

Nachum is understood as the one asking before Yochanan; the clause is integrated, not a newly imposed quotation. Supplied ר׳ יוחנן differs from older machine ף! חנן. Brother-of direction remains, and all three title abbreviations remain R'.
